items.title: Onaje Allan Gumbs interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001
items.q: So by the time Cannonball got to the campus we tried to question him about all this stuff. He said “well they told me to come for one day.”

ctx.x: I was not hip to what was going on with that. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -11-

It was very political. Because they were going to do a three day seminar. The whole seminar was going to cost five thousand dollars. Then it went down to four thousand dollars. Because it was something that the students were going to kind of do. It wasn’t something that was put together by faculty. Students had got wind of this educational thing that Cannonball was doing and they felt we needed to get that. And it’s a great story man. It’s unbelievable too, I’m surprised you don’t know everything that went down.…
